name: BROADSTONE NET LEASE INC-A
summary: BROADSTONE NET LEASE INC-A is a real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns and operates a diversified portfolio of single-tenant net leased properties. Headquartered in Rochester, New York, the company's portfolio includes properties leased to tenants in various industries, including retail, healthcare, and industrial. Broadstone Net Lease aims to generate stable and growing income for its shareholders.
